newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Nan Ya Jan sales up 9.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Nan Ya Jan sales up 9.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Nan Ya Plastics Corp, Taiwan's largest private industrial firm, said on Tuesday its sales rose 9.3 percent in January to T$7.498 billion from T$6.859 billion a year earlier.
But the January sales fell 7.8 percent from December's T$8.131 billion, the company said in a statement.
Its full-year 1996 sales fell 2.9 percent to T$88.865 billion from T$91.494 billion in 1995.
The statement did not provide profit figures.
Nan Ya said it has set a sales target of T$94.921 billion for 1997.
Nan Ya is a key member of Formosa Plastics group.
